entries.name: Spiritual Advancement
entries.text:
When characters survive exceptionally dangerous encounters by the narrowest of margins, standard rewards such as treasure or XP may not fully reflect their growth.
With the DM’s approval, such moments may grant a Spirit Surge Event, representing a surge of personal power earned through hardship. Spirit Surges are typically awarded for defeating powerful foes, overcoming major threats, or surviving extraordinary challenges, though the DM may also grant them in place of magic items or other rewards.
When a Spirit Surge Event occurs, each affected player chooses to unlock a Haki or Devil Fruit Advancement. The rarity of the Spirit Surge sets the maximum rarity of the advancement that may be chosen. For example, a Rare Spirit Surge allows the selection of a Rare or lower advancement. Use the Spirit Surge Event table to determine the allowed rarity; this need not rely strictly on Challenge Rating.

sections.name: Variant Rule: Amateur Haki
sections.text:
As characters journey through dangerous encounters, they may start to experience subtle hints of latent power. To capture this development phase, DMs can implement Amateur Haki, allowing players to unlock small, early-stage Haki abilities before they enter the Grand Line.
Instead of granting players an Uncommon spirit surge, consider give them a Common spirit surge instead. This early game haki is for players who are level 1 - 4 and tones back players power early game as they are just learning their ropes in one of the Four Blues.
Once players hit level 5 or enters the grand line, Amateur Haki upgrades into its Uncommon variants.

entries.name: Willpower Score
entries.text:
Haki is a mysterious power that allows individuals to harness their own spiritual energy for various superhuman feats.
Willpower is a unique stat that is different from ability scores. Each character starts with a Willpower stat of 1, regardless of their other stats. However, whenever you gain a character level you also increase your willpower stat by +1.
This score does not have a modifier like ability scores it is its own thing, just use the base amount of willpower when calculating haki features.
Spirit Surge Variant: Each character starts with a Willpower stat of 0. Whenever you gain a Spiritual Advancement you also increase your willpower stat by +1 up to a maximum of 20.

rows: Taking down a tough Blue Seas Captain.
Taking down a famous Grand Line Captain.
Defeating a Warlord, Sea King, ect.

entries.name: Haki Spellcasting Ability
entries.text:
Willpower is your spellcasting ability for your color of armament, observation, and supreme king features.
Haki save DC = 10 + half of your Willpower (rounded up)

entries.name: Haki Tiers
entries.text:
Each Color of Haki is divided into three tiers of mastery. Haki tiers are tracked separately for each Color. Amateur Haki does not count towards increasing tiers.
To unlock higher Haki tiers for a given Color, you must possess a minimum number of Haki features of that same Color. You unlock Tier 2 Haki with 4 features of the same color and you unlock Tier 3 with 6 total features, regardless of the tiers of those features. You do not lose progress in your haki tiers for features that replace other features, and haki gained from classes and subclasses count towards your tier progression.

entries.name: Haki Purist
entries.text:
Starting at 4th level, and then again at 10th, and 16th , you may choose one of the following Haki improvement effects. You immediately lose access to all of these improvements when your character gains Devil Fruit powers.
Train Quality. Increase the amount of dice rolled from your haki features by 1.
Train Quantity. Increase the initial area of effect range of your haki features by 15 feet.
If taken at 20th level this instead increases the range of your legendary haki features aoe by double.
Train Stamina. Increase the amount of charges for your uncommon and rare haki features by +1.

entries.name: Standard Surge Advancement
entries.text: If you do not want a haki or devil fruit advancement, you may choose from the following features below. The rarity of the standard advancement feature you may choose is determined by the Spirit Surge Event.

entries.name: Career Advancement
entries.text:
Gain proficiency in 1 skill of your choice, if you already have proficiency with a chosen skill gain expertise instead.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Learn Technique
entries.text:
Gain two cantrips of your choice from any spell list.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Strengthen Self
entries.text:
Add +2 to a ability score of your choice or +2 to your willpower score (both have a maximum of 20). Willpower still may only go up to 20 when leveling.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Unjustified Reputation
entries.text:
Double your current bounty and EVERYONE now knows your face and achievements. If a creature is friendly towards you, you gain advantage on charisma skill roles.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Warriors Path
entries.text:
Gain proficiency with a weapon or armor type of your choice.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Improve Special Reactions
entries.text:
You gain +1 use for all special reaction features.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Learn Custom Spell
entries.text:
Learn a spell from the Custom Spell List in Chapter 4. The spell you learn must be of a spell level you can cast.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Multipurpose Weapon
entries.text:
You modify your current weapon. Choose another weapon you own (and are proficient with) and merge them together. You may switch between these multipurpose weapon ‘modes’ with a bonus action.
Additionally, If you make an attack action, you may use a bonus action after making your attack to switch your multipurpose weapon to a new ‘mode’. Switching to a new mode in this way lets you make an additional multipurpose weapon attack will disadvantage.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times and on the same multipurpose weapon.

entries.name: Borrow Skill
entries.text:
Learn a single feature from a class or subclass of your choice. You cannot pick a feature that is a higher level than your current character level.
The class feature and/or subclass feature can not be from any class you currently have levels in and you cannot grab a feature that grants spell slots.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Muscle Memory
entries.text:
Double the amount of uses of one class feature.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Quick Learner
entries.text:
Your character gains +1 level (max 20). This level can be used to increase your current class level or multiclass into a new class.
This advancement can be chosen multiple times.

entries.name: Color of Armament Advancement
entries.text: When deciding to advance your Color of Armament Haki during a Spirit Surge Event, you may choose any of the following features below. The rarity of the haki advancement feature you may choose is determined by the Spirit Surge Event.

entries.name: Focused Hit
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You find chips in your opponents defense.
Once per turn, your weapon attacks and unarmed strikes deal increased damage. Whenever you roll damage dice for a weapon or unarmed strike, increase each die by one size up to a maximum of d8 (e.g., 1d4’s becomes 1d6’s, 1d6’s become 1d8’s, ect).
Upgrades to Enhanced Strike when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Fortitude
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You instinctively draw upon your inner strength, toughening your body.
You can spend an action to gain 1d4 + your character level in temporary hit points. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
Upgrades to Aura of Life when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Resolve Within
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You channel an inner resilience that strengthens your physical form.
As an action, you can bolster your defenses until the end of your next turn. During this time, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
Upgrades to Vessel of Resilience when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Aura of Life
entries.text:
You are able to increase your willpower to bolster the toughness of your body using your spirit.
You can spend an action to gain 1d6 + half of your Willpower (rounded up) + your character level in temporary hit points. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Enhanced Strike
entries.text:
You learn how to look for weaknesses in a opponents defense.
Your weapon attacks and unarmed strikes deal increased damage. Whenever you roll damage dice for a weapon or unarmed strike, increase the base weapon/unarmed strike die by one size up to a maximum of d12 (e.g., 1d4’s becomes 1d6’s, 1d6’s become 1d8’s, ect).
You cannot increase the dice size of haki or class feature related dice.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Soul Armor
entries.text:
You can form a thin coating of invisible armor around your body using your soul.
As an action, you surround your body with this armor, making your AC equal to 10 + your proficiency bonus + half of your Willpower (rounded up), maximum of 20 AC, when you aren’t wearing armor. This armor lasts for 8 hours. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Vessel of Resilience
entries.text:
You learn to imbue your spirit with such resilience that it enhances your physical form.
As an action, you can bolster your defenses for 1 minute. During this time, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and you have advantage on Constitution saving throws. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Force of Will
entries.text:
Your iron-will enables you to unleash devastating shockwaves of Haki energy. As an action, you slam your foot or fist into the ground, releasing a shockwave of spirit energy. Each creature within 30 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes force damage equal to 1d10 + a number of d10s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up) and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone. Structures and nonmagical objects in the area take double damage. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Internal Destruction
entries.text:
Your mastery of Haki allows you to let your spirit energy linger, echoing your strikes with unyielding force.
As a bonus action when you hit a creature with a melee weapon or unarmed strike, your spirit energy reverberates through the target causing it to take additional force damage equal to a number of d6s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up) at the start of each of its turns for the next minute. The creature can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect early on a success. If you hit the same creature with this effect again before the duration ends, the effect’s damage stacks and the duration resets.
Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Soul Ravage
entries.text:
You have learned how to directly channel lethal energy into any living creature, ravaging the powers of Devil Fruit users.
When you hit a devil fruit creature with a melee attack you can choose to subdue it’s powers, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is unable to use Devil Fruit abilities, spells, or forms until the end of its next turn. Any Devil Fruit spells that use concentration and any Devil Fruit forms or abilities the creature has active are also ended early, as if it was touched by seastone.
Once you use this ability you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Soul Shield
entries.text:
You are capable of coating dense amounts of haki around your body.
If a creature hits you with a melee attack. It takes 1d8 force damage.
Additionally, you can cast the Shield spell on yourself without expending a spell slot. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down), you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Spirit Blast
entries.text:
You gain the ability to send bursts of energy through your enemies using your spirit.
When you hit a creature with a weapon attack or unarmed strike, you can unleash a surge of spirit energy from your body to deal extra 1d4 force damage to the target, in addition to the attack’s normal damage.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Weapon Hardening
entries.text:
You gain the ability to coat your weapons and attacks with your spirit. The heavier the application, the darker the coating is.
As a bonus action, you channel haki into your body or a weapon of your choice. If you choose your body, you choose either your unarmed strikes or a natural weapon. For 1 minute, your attacks with the chosen weapon are considered magical with a bonus to Attack rolls and Damage Rolls equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up).
If the attack already has a bonus to its attack and damage rolls, this feature replaces the bonus unless it is greater, in which case it does not gain this feature’s benefit.
This effect ends early if you fall unconscious, use it again, end it as a bonus action, or start your turn not holding or touching the weapon you coated. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Blackened Fist of Ruin
entries.typeLine: Armament Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
Your spiritual energy can focus into a single devastating punch that shatters any defense.
As an action, you can make a single melee weapon attack against a creature within reach. If this attack hits, it deals additional force damage equal to 2d10 + a number of d10s equal to half of your Willpower (rounded up), and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked back 30 feet and knocked prone. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Bullet of Will
entries.typeLine: Armament Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
Your control over your Haki extends beyond your body, imbuing your ranged attacks with potent force.
When you make a ranged attack, you can use a bonus action to imbue your projectile with your Haki, causing it to deal an additional force damage equal to 2d8 + a number of d8s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up). Furthermore, the attack has a maximum range of 1200 feet with no disadvantage due to long-range. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Crippling Blast
entries.typeLine: Armament Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
You enhance your ability to send bursts of energy through your attacks and can now physically destroy your enemies from the inside.
When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you deal extra force damage equal to a number of d8s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up) and force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can’t take reactions, until the end of its next turn. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Spirit Emission
entries.typeLine: Armament Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
You concentrate your Haki into a potent beam of energy, piercing through multiple enemies.
As an action, you can fire a beam of energy in a line that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes force damage equal to 2d10 + a number of d10s equal to half of your Willpower (rounded up) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This beam penetrates through creatures and objects, potentially hitting multiple targets in its path. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Will Redirection
entries.typeLine: Armament Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
Your spiritual force can now redirect harm to yourself and withstand its damage.
As a reaction, when you or a creature within 30 feet of you is targeted by a spell or ability that deals damage, you can use your Haki to intercept the attack. The damage is redirected to you, but you only take half damage (rounded down). Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Abyssal Hole
entries.text:
You’ve refined your Armament Haki to a point where you can channel both its overwhelming force and your intimidating spirit into a single destructive blow, capable of sending foes plummeting into an abyss.
As an action, you can make a melee attack against an opponent within reach. If the attack hits, you envelop your hand in concentrated Haki and smash your opponent into the ground, dealing force damage equal to a number of d10s equal to your Willpower and forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the enemy is sent crashing downwards 50 feet, taking any additional fall damage, and creating a gaping hole in the ground if the area is able to be destroyed, and is knocked prone and stunned until the end of its next turn.
If used on a surface not connected to a substantial amount of earth (such as the deck of a ship or a wooden floor), this ability will instead break through a single surface and cause the enemy to fall through to the surface below, dealing the same amount of force damage to any objects hit.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Dark Armor
entries.text:
You can create a nearly indestructible coat of Haki that guards you from all harm.
As an action, you can envelop yourself in a layer of super-dense Haki. For the next 10 minutes, you gain resistance to all types of damage except force, your Armor Class can’t be less than 5 + your Willpower, regardless of what kind of armor you are wearing, and you are immune to being grappled or restrained. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Galaxy Impact
entries.text:
You have reached the pinnacle of Armament Haki, gaining the ability to impose your spirit’s might on the world around you.
As an action, you can cause a burst of pure force to radiate from you. All creatures and objects within a 120 ft. radius must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes force damage equal to 4d10 + a number of d10s equal to half of your Willpower (rounded up) and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone. Unworn objects automatically fail their saving throw and take full damage. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Permanent Black Weapon
entries.text:
or Conqueror’s Coating
You coat a weapon with a permanent layer of dark energy that never leaves it.
Choose a weapon that is separate from your body. You spend 1 hour infusing it with your spirit. It receives the bonuses from Weapon Hardening or Conqueror’s Coating permanently until you end it by spending 1 hour to remove it.
Additionally when you reach Willpower 16, you can choose to infuse the weapon with additional power. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Each of your successful attacks with the weapon deal an extra 4d6 damage of the chosen type.
Only one weapon can receive the benefits permanent infusion at a time. If a creature other than you attempts to use this weapon, it must attune to the weapon to gain its benefits. You can still use Weapon Hardening or Conqueror’s Coating normally on separate weapons while this infusion is active.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Thunderbolt Volley
entries.text:
You have harnessed the strength of your spirit to such a degree that you can channel it into your ranged attacks, causing them to hit with the force of a thunderbolt.
As an action, select one target you can see within range and make a ranged weapon attack. You fire a single shot imbued with your Haki, which splits into multiple thundering energy bolts mid-flight. Make a single weapon attack roll. On a hit, the target suffers the normal effects of the weapon attack, and it takes additional force damage equal to 6d10 + a number of d10s equal to half of your Willpower (rounded up).
Then, up to six other targets of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the original target each take force damage equal to the additional force damage roll.
After the attack, the force of the unleashed energy causes a thunderous boom that is audible up to 1 mile feet.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Color of Observation Advancement
entries.text: When deciding to advance your Color of Observation Haki during a Spirit Surge Event, you may choose any of the following features below. The rarity of the haki advancement feature you may choose is determined by the Spirit Surge Event.

entries.name: Instinctual Awareness
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You’ve honed a mysterious intuition, allowing you to sense the presence of beings more efficiently.
You gain a +2 bonus to your passive Wisdom (Perception).
Upgrades to Spirit Sense when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Keen Gaze
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You develop a sense for tracking far off objects.
As a bonus action, choose one of the following effects to apply to your ranged weapon attack:
Your attack roll adds an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.
The range of your ranged weapon attack is doubled.
You cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
Upgrades to Far Sight when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Lucky Shot
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You’ve developed a knack for making impossible shots.
When you make a ranged weapon attack and miss, you can use your bonus action to reroll the attack against a different creature within range. The fired missile ricochets off a solid surface, such as a wall or a ceiling, before heading towards the new target. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
Upgrades to Echoing Shot when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Aura Detection
entries.text:
You begin to see auras around people and objects that allow you to identify devil fruit users and obtain information about them.
As an action, you sense the presence of haki and devil fruit users within 120 feet of you, learning if it has Haki and/or a Devil Fruit. After learning its powers, you may additionally determine one of the following properties per creature detected:
It’s maximum Haki or Devil Fruit rarity.
It’s prominent Haki types.
It’s Devil Fruit type.
If the Devil Fruit is Awakened.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Aura Reading
entries.text:
You are able to detect the presence and potential threat level of dangerous creatures or hazards around you.
You can cast the Detect Poison and Disease and Find Traps spells without expending a spell slot or material components. Additionally the range of your Detect Poison and Disease is increased to 120 ft. and you can sense the location of traps with Find Traps.
When you reach Willpower 10, you may also cast Detect Thoughts, without expending spell slots or material components. The range of this spell is 60 feet.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Echoing Shot
entries.text:
You have learned to channel your Observation Haki into your ranged attacks, enabling your shots to curve mid-air.
When you make a ranged weapon attack and miss, you can use your bonus action to reroll the attack against a different creature within range. The fired missile ricochets off a solid surface, such as a wall or a ceiling, before heading towards the new target. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Far Sight
entries.text:
Your observation haki allows you to perceive threats from a significant distance.
As a bonus action, choose one of the following effects to apply to your ranged weapon attack:
Your attack roll has advantage.
The range of your ranged weapon attack is tripled.
You can use this feature an amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Predictive Strike
entries.text:
Through honing your perception, you can predict your opponent’s movements, turning their offense into an opportunity for a counterattack.
When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the creature. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Spirit Sense
entries.text:
You have trained your haki to feel the presence of beings who are invisible, hidden or disguised.
You gain a +8 bonus to your passive Wisdom (Perception) and you can see invisible creatures. Additionally, you can sense the location hidden creatures within 30 feet of you.
When you reach Willpower 10, your senses increase to 60 ft. and you can automatically tell if you are looking at an illusion.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Echo of Futures Past
entries.text:
You’ve honed your Observation Haki to a point where you can shortly glimpse into the future, anticipating your enemies defenses.
When you roll for initiative, you gain advantage on all your attack rolls until the end of your first turn.
Additionally, you can take the Dodge action as a bonus action instead of an action on your turns.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Hawk’s Gaze
entries.text:
Your Observation Haki gives you sight beyond sight, allowing you to spot distant threats and targets with ease.
You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. In addition, you can make out details of creatures and objects up to 1 mile away.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Imminent Sense
entries.text:
Your ability to predict danger has reached new heights, allowing you to effectively dodge even the deadliest strikes.
When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Predict Outcome
entries.text:
You can see a tiny glimpse into the future to determine the potential negative outcome of a situation and avoid it.
When you or an ally within 30 ft. of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can choose to reroll the outcome of the d20 as a reaction. You may reroll the die once the outcome of the initial roll is determined.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Predictive Attack
entries.text:
Your haki allows you to predict the trajectory of your enemies movement with uncanny precision.
When you make an attack roll, you can choose to use this feature before the attack goes off. The attack ignores cover, the target’s Dexterity Modifier to calculate it’s AC, and critically hits on a roll of 19 or 20. On a hit, the attack deals additional damage equal to a number of d6s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up).
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Traveling Gaze
entries.text:
By amplifying your vision with your spirit, you are able to see through physical objects.
You can cast the Arcane Eye spell, without expending a spell slot or material components an amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
Additionally, you and your Arcane Eye gain the ability to see through solid objects to a range of 30 feet. Within that range, you have darkvision if you don’t already have it and cant see through magical darkness, perceiving objects and creatures you can’t see as ghostly, transparent images.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Chronostasis
entries.typeLine: Observation Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
You perceive time in a unique way, allowing you to analyze your surroundings and react to threats with greater precision.
You can take the ‘Ready’ action as a bonus action on your turn.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Glimpse into the Future
entries.typeLine: Observation Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
By developing your sixth sense, you can see further into the future.
When you finish a long rest, roll two 1d20s and record the numbers rolled. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by you or a creature that you can see with one of these foretelling rolls. You must choose to do so before the roll, and you can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each foretelling roll can be used only once. When you finish a long rest, you lose any unused foretelling rolls.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Infinite Sight
entries.typeLine: Observation Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
By focusing your spiritual awareness on distant surroundings, you can focus on specific areas to see or hear targets from far away.
You can cast the Clairvoyance spell at will, without expending a spell slot or material components. You may have an amount of Clairvoyance spells active equal to your proficiency bonus.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Preemptive Strike
entries.typeLine: Observation Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
Your heightened observation skills allow you to react to threats with lightning speed, attacking before your enemy can even strike.
As a reaction when a creature you can see within range initiates an attack against you, you can make one weapon attack against the creature. If your attack hits, the creature’s attack is canceled and they lose their action. This feature doesn’t prevent the creature from using a bonus action or reaction.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Soul Gaze
entries.typeLine: Observation Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
You’ve refined your Observation Haki to perceive the spirit of people around you and information about them.
You gain advantage on all Wisdom (Insight) checks and as an action, you sense the presence of haki and devil fruit users within 120 feet of you, learning all of the following information:
It’s current Hit Points.
It’s Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities It’s maximum Haki and Devil Fruit rarities.
It’s prominent Haki types.
It’s Devil Fruit type.
If the Devil Fruit is Awakened.
This feature replaces Aura Detection.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Clairvoyant Strike
entries.text:
Your foresight enables you to strike where your enemies are most vulnerable.
As a bonus action, for 3 rounds when you make an attack you can give yourself a bonus to your attack rolls equal to your Willpower score. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Future Sight
entries.text:
You perceive brief flashes of the immediate future, allowing you to evade attacks before they are fully formed.
At the start of each round of combat, you gain three Future Sight dodges. When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can expend one Future Sight dodge to cause that attack to automatically miss. In addition, you have advantage on the first three saving throws you make each round.
Creatures that also possess Future Sight ignore all benefits of this feat when affecting you.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: The Zone
entries.text:
In the heat of battle, you can enter a state of total spatial awareness and the ability to see clearly into the future for a prolonged period of time.
You can spend an action to center your focus around your sixth sense and gain the benefits of the Foresight spell for 1 hour. This effect ends early if you fall unconscious or end it as a bonus action.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Color of the Supreme King Advancement
entries.text:
When deciding to advance your Color of the Supreme King Haki during a Spirit Surge Event, you may choose any of the following features below. The rarity of the haki advancement feature you may choose is determined by the Spirit Surge Event.
In order to gain a King’s Haki Advancement feature, you are required to have “Qualities of a King” (see below).

sections.name: Qualities of a King
sections.text:
To determine if you are born with the rare ability to awaken King’s Haki, you must roll a d20 before or during character creation. If the result is 20, you are born with this gift.
Sometimes, an individual does not know they have this type of haki until much later in their life. When you gain a Ability Score Improvement from your class, you may reroll your Quality of a King roll with advantage.
Alternatively, the DM may choose to permit certain player characters or NPCs to use King’s Haki without needing to roll, or simply allow the entire group to use it by default.

entries.name: Commanding Tone
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
Your words carry an heavy weight, compelling others to follow your lead.
As an action, you can speak a command to a creature you can see within 10 feet of you. The command must be a sentence of no more than ten words. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn to the best of its ability. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
Upgrades to Lord’s Demand when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Character level 1-4

entries.name: Compelling Tone
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You naturally inspire others and sway their actions, as though born with a quiet authority that draws people to you.
You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.
Upgrades to Voice of Influence when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Character level 1-4

entries.name: Intimidating Look
entries.typeLine: Amateur Haki Advancement, Common — No Tier
entries.text:
You emanate a presence that makes others feel an inexplicable sense of helplessness.
You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.
Upgrades to Roar of the Monarch when you reach character level 5
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Character level 1-4

entries.name: King’s Companion
entries.text:
You are able to influence the souls of tiny magical spirits around you, gaining their assistance and occasional servitude.
You can cast the Find Familiar spell as a ritual without using any material components. The familiar must take on one of the stat blocks listed by the spell, but can appear as any tiny creature you desire, perhaps representing your spirit animal.
Additionally, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction.
When you reach Willpower 10, the familiar can be infused with one haki feature you know as an action, storing your power within it. This feature ends when you order the familiar to use it, or when the familiar is dismissed. If the feature requires willpower, it uses your willpower score.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: King’s Resolve
entries.text:
Your indomitable spirit can overcome even the most dire circumstances.
As a reaction when you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Lord’s Demand
entries.text:
Your haki-infused words compel obedience, manipulating others into doing your bidding.
As an action, you can speak a command to a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The command must be a sentence of no more than a single command that is three words. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn to the best of its ability. The command cannot be used to directly or indirectly harm the creature. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Roar of the Monarch
entries.text:
Your powerful will resonates through your voice, making it a weapon on its own. You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.
As an action, you can release a thunderous yell. Each creature within a 15 ft. cone must make a Constitution saving throw or be deafened and frightened of you for 1 minute. Creatures may make the save again at the end of its turns. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Voice of Influence
entries.text:
Being born with qualities of a king, you find it easy to spread your ideas to others and influence their behavior.
You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills. You can cast the Charm Person spell, without expending a spell slot or material components. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Command the Battlefield
entries.text:
Your King’s Haki is so potent that it affects the battlefield, tipping the scales in your favor.
As an action, you can issue a command that affects the terrain in a 60 ft. radius centered on you for 1 minute. The effect is determined by the command you choose:
Hold: The ground becomes difficult terrain for your enemies.
Fall: Small fissures appear, causing your enemies to have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Rise: Small walls of earth provide cover for you and your allies, providing half cover against all ranged attacks.
For the duration of this ability, you may spend an additional action during your turn to change the current command to a different one. Once the duration ends, you can’t use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: King’s Radiance
entries.text:
Your spirit’s energy radiates from you, making it difficult for enemies to approach.
As an action, you can cause a burst of Haki energy to radiate from you for an extended duration. For 1 minute or until you fall unconscious, you emit a 15 ft. radius of bright light, and when the creature enters the area for the first time in a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes psychic damage equal to a number of d10s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up) and falls prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn’t fall prone. You must also concentrate on this ability as if it were a spell. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: King’s Wrath
entries.text:
The sheer force of your kingly spirit is enough to harm those who oppose you.
As an action, you can unleash a burst of spiritual energy. Each creature of your choice within a 20 ft. radius centered on you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes psychic damage equal to a number of d8s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up) and is stunned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t stunned. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Leader of the Animal Kingdom
entries.text:
Through becoming familiar with various beasts and monsters, you have learned to pacify or influence them with your overwhelming charisma.
You can cast the Animal Friendship spell at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.
You can also cast the Charm Monster spell, without expending a spell slot once per short or long rest.
When you reach Willpower 16, you can cast the Dominate Monster spell, without expending a spell slot. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Supreme Terror
entries.text:
You exert your powerful spirit, inciting an overwhelming sense of fear in those who dare oppose you.
As an action, you can force all creatures of your choice within a 60 ft. radius of you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is stunned until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Dread Sovereign’s Roar
entries.typeLine: King’s Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
With a shout imbued with the force of your indomitable spirit, you evoke primal fear in those who dare to oppose you.
As an action, you can unleash a powerful roar that resonates with your King’s Haki. All creatures of your choice within 120 ft. of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes an amount of force damage equal to a number of d12s equal to half of your Willpower (rounded up) and is stunned until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This feature replaces Supreme Terror.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Supreme Terror

entries.name: Observation Killer
entries.typeLine: King’s Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
Your supreme will creates an aura that confuses and disorients the senses of others, effectively countering their Observation Haki.
As a bonus action, you can create a 30 ft. radius aura centered on you and that follows you. This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you’re incapacitated. While within this aura, no observation haki features may be used by any creature.
Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Sovereign’s Resolve
entries.typeLine: King’s Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
Your willpower is so profound that it acts as a bulwark against mental intrusions and manipulation.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that would charm, frighten, or possess you. Moreover, if you succeed on a saving throw against such a spell or effect, the creature who cast the spell or caused the effect must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for 1 minute.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Willpower Ravage
entries.typeLine: King’s Haki Advancement, Very Rare — Tier 2
entries.text:
By focusing all of your willpower and spirit onto a single creature within range, you are able to cripple its mind and soul, including the soul of the devil inside it if it is a Devil Fruit user.
You can cast the Phantasmal Killer spell, without expending a spell slot. While a creature is influenced by this spell on a failed save using this feature, it is unable to use Devil Fruit abilities, spells, or forms until the spell ends. Any Devil Fruit spells that use concentration and any Devil Fruit forms or abilities the creature has active are also ended early. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Conqueror’s Bulwark
entries.text:
You can fortify not just yourself, but also your allies against the crushing force of other conquerors. Your indomitable spirit stands as a testament of your unyielding resolve.
After taking this feat, you are immune to the frightened condition and any effects that can incapacitate or stun you by means of Conqueror’s Haki.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that would charm or possess you and if you succeed on a saving throw against such a spell or effect, the creature who cast the spell or caused the effect must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for 1 minute.
Moreover, as an action, you can extend this powerful protection to your comrades for 1 hour. All allied creatures within a 60 ft. radius of you gain immunity to the frightened condition and the first time they would be incapacitated or stunned by Conqueror’s Haki, they are not.
Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This feature replaces Sovereign’s Resolve.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Sovereign’s Resolve

entries.name: Conqueror’s Coating
entries.text:
Through rigorous training and self-discovery, you have learned to manifest your Armament and King’s Haki in their most potent form, transforming your weapon into an extension of your indomitable will.
As a bonus action, you channel haki into your body or a weapon of your choice. If you choose your body, you choose either your unarmed strikes or a natural weapon. For 1 minute, gain the following effects on your weapon:
Your attacks with the chosen weapon are considered magical with a bonus to Attack rolls and Damage Rolls equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up).
Your weapon’s damage type becomes Force.
Your reach with that weapon increases by 10 feet. When you attack and hit a creature with this weapon, you can choose to push the creature up to 10 feet away from you.
The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or is stunned until the start of your next turn.
If the attack already has a bonus to its attack and damage rolls, this feature replaces the bonus unless it is greater, in which case it does not gain this feature’s benefit.
This effect ends early if you fall unconscious, use it again, end it as a bonus action, or start your turn not holding or touching the weapon you coated. Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This feature replaces Weapon Hardening.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Weapon Hardening

entries.name: Conqueror’s Infusion
entries.text:
You gain the ability to transfer your conqueror’s haki into mundane items, letting another user use your spirit.
After ten minutes of concentration, You can cast a Color of the Supreme King ability into the object by touching the object as the ability is cast. The object must not be any larger than 20 feet. by 20 feet. The ability has no effect, other than to be stored in the item. If the item already has haki infused into it, it can’t hold another ability. You can infuse an amount of items equal to your proficiency bonus, but you must take a long rest between each cast.
While holding this item, a creature can cast any ability stored within it with an action. The ability uses the Haki save DC and damage of the original infuser, but is otherwise treated as if that creature cast the ability. The ability cast from the object is no longer stored in it.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Conqueror’s Maelstrom
entries.text:
Your will is a force of nature, an untamed storm that can bring even the skies to submission. Your potent Haki can resonate with the atmosphere itself, causing the elements to dance to the rhythm of your spirit.
As an action, you unleash your full King’s Haki, producing a cataclysmic atmospheric manifestation visible for miles. The moment Conqueror’s Maelstrom is unleashed, every hostile creature within 300 ft. of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is stunned until the end of your next turn. After the stun ends, the creature is frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a success, the creature is not stunned or frightened.
Additionally, choose one of the following effects when you activate this feature, and all creatures within 10 miles will become aware of the your location:
Sky Splitter. You immediately dispel all nonmagical weather in a 1 mile radius centered on you. Magical weather of a spell level lower than your proficiency bonus is also suppressed for the duration. This effect persists for 1 hour, until you fall unconscious, or until you dismiss it (no action required), after which normal weather resumes.
Lightning Dominion. You conjure a Haki-infused lightning storm. The storm cloud appears in the sky 100 feet directly above you with a radius of 300 feet. When the storm first manifests and on each of your turns while it persists, you may use your action to call down Conqueror’s Lightning. When you do so, each hostile creature under the cloud takes an amount of force damage equal to a number of d10s equal to a quarter of your Willpower (rounded up) as lightning strikes down around them. The storm lasts for 1 minute, until you fall unconscious, or until you dismiss it (no action required).
Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Unyielding Conqueror’s Wrath

entries.name: Conqueror’s Tether
entries.text:
As an action, you unleash a massive tether of Supreme King Haki in a chosen direction. One creature of your choice within 1 mile of you that you know the location of must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Haki save DC or take an amount of force damage equal to a number of d10s equal to your Willpower and be stunned until the end of your next turn. On a success, the creature takes no damage and is not stunned, it is instead frightened of you for 1 minute. This creature cannot remove the frightened condition from this feature.
Once you use this ability you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Unyielding Conqueror’s Wrath

entries.name: Divine Departure
entries.text:
You have mastered the art of channeling your Haki into an explosive leap, propelling yourself towards your enemy and delivering a devastating blow.
As an action, you can choose a point you can see within 60 ft. of you. You leap to that point, and you can make a single melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of your landing spot. This attack is made with advantage, and if the attack hits, it deals an additional amount of force damage equal to a number of d10s equal to your Willpower. The force from your landing also creates a shockwave that spreads out from the point of impact. All creatures within a 15 ft. radius of your landing point must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take force damage equal to a number of d10s equal to half of your Willpower (rounded up) and are knocked prone. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and are not knocked prone.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Conqueror’s Coating

entries.name: Lasting Will
entries.text:
You are able to nullify any active devil fruit effects by breaking them with your willpower.
You can cast the Dispel Magic spell at will, without expending a spell slot. This only works on active spells or effects caused or created by Devil Fruit powers.
Additionally while your Conqueror’s Coating is active, if a target is has a trait such as Regeneration or Immortality, it loses those benefits until the start of your next turn and only regains half the hit points granted by magical or nonmagical sources.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Conqueror’s Coating

entries.name: Lord’s Mirror
entries.text:
Your strong spirit can be used to deflect harmful effects back to their origin. When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you (not an area effect), you can use your reaction to force the originator to make a saving throw using the same DC. On a failure, the originator is affected by the spell or effect as if they were the original target. After using this feature, you must finish a long rest before using it again.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: The Voice of All Things
entries.text:
You have learned to use your rare natural talent to tune into the wavelengths of all forms of communication in the world.
You can read and understand all languages, written or verbal, including any writing on poneglyphs. You can also cast the Commune with Nature and Speak With Animals spells at will, without expending a spell slots or material components. When using this spell, you can communicate with all types of creatures in the same way you would be able to with a beast.
Additionally, you can speak telepathically with any creature within 1 mile of you whether they are in the same dimension as you or not.
This advancement can be chosen once.

entries.name: Unyielding Conqueror’s Wrath
entries.text:
The sheer force of your indomitable spirit is a deadly tempest that can devastate those who oppose you.
As an action, you can release an all-consuming wave of pure willpower that resonates from your very core. All creatures of your choice within 300 ft. of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes an amount of force damage equal to a number of d12s equal to your Willpower and is knocked prone and stunned until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone or stunned. Beasts with an Intelligence score of 8 or lower automatically fail their saving throw.
Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
This feature replaces Dread Sovereign’s Roar.
This advancement can be chosen once.
entries.prerequisite: Qualities of a King, Dread Sovereign’s Roar

entries.name: Spirit Surge Training
entries.text: While the thrill of adventure and the heat of battle can certainly shape a character, more deliberate forms of learning have their place in the journey of character growth. Training provides a way for characters to continue to grow their Haki and Devil Fruit techniques during downtime, but for a price.

sections.name: Training Surges
sections.text:
A Training Surge represents a concentrated period of guided training and practice. These periods can occur during downtime, between quests, or during long sea voyages. They allow characters to focus on honing their abilities, exploring the extent of their powers, or developing new strategies for battle.
To initiate a Training Surge—an alternate method to activating Spirit Surges—a set of prerequisites must first be met. Primarily, a tutor is necessary to begin the process. Locating a qualified tutor can be a challenging task, and the level of Spirit Surge they can impart through training will vary based on their expertise. Although a tutor can instruct multiple students simultaneously, they will charge an individual fee for each trainee. Some tutors may work for free if characters are in their good graces. Once a tutor has been identified and compensated, the trainee must devote a substantial and consistent period to the training, as specified in the ‘Training Fees and Time’ table provided below.

sections.name: Training Time and Cost
sections.text:
During the training period, a character is considered to be in downtime and cannot participate in other activities, adventures, or battles. They are fully committed to the training and the development of their powers. However, they will be rewarded with enhanced abilities and a deeper understanding of their Haki or Devil Fruit powers at the end of the process.
Once the total training time has gone by without any issues, any creature participating in the training will receive a spirit surge according to the type of training they chose using the table above.

sections.name: Optional Rule: Solo Training
sections.text: The DM can alternatively allow a character to train without the guidance of a tutor or mentor. If so, use the table below to calculate training time and cost. The cost represents expenses needed for resources and equipment while training.
